cases.title: Sender asks who needs to sign
steps: Click the suggestion "Who needs to sign?"
Click a page reference such as "(p. 3)" in the answer
expected: "Thinking…" shows, then an answer naming the parties, with page references
Clicking the page reference scrolls the preview to that page

cases.title: Signer asks about their obligations
steps: Type "How long do my obligations last?" into the question box and press Enter
expected: The answer quotes the document's term with a page reference
The panel says answers come from the document only and are not legal advice

cases.title: Off-topic question is declined
steps: Type "What's the weather in Paris?" and send it
expected: The answer politely says it can only answer from this document
